svg.title: PF1550: Control connections to a host processor
svg.desc: Schematic of the PF1550 control connections to a host processor: the chip with U2 Host, R1 resistor 2.2 kΩ, R2 resistor 2.2 kΩ, R3 resistor 10 kΩ; the MCU wires carry the port hooks GpioGet(CtrlPin::Intb), GpioSet(CtrlPin::Standby), Write(), WriteRead().
svg.text: PF1550: Control connections to a host processor

The PF1550 on a host's I2C bus with the STANDBY pin driven by a GPIO through GpioSet() and INTB read by GpioGet(). The power connections (battery, supply, regulator outputs and their capacitors) are in the data sheet's
example schematic and are not redrawn here. Above each MCU wire: the port hook that drives it. Datasheet: 13.1 Example schematic, p. 133.

* Not confirmed in the datasheet: R1 2.2 kΩ: typical value for 400 kHz; size it for the bus; R2 2.2 kΩ: typical value for 400 kHz; size it for the bus; R3 10 kΩ: INTB is open drain; any value that suits the host input.
